set.n: Ray Yocum's lost fruit jar of $2,300, Yocum yard, East Lincoln Highway, DeKalb
set.pl: Yocum yard, East Lincoln Highway, DeKalb (house number not yet known); pin on E Lincoln Hwy E of downtown
set.tovw: $2,300 jar buried in his own yard Nov 1938, never relocated
set.st: Ray Yocum, 42, a garage owner, buried a fruit jar with $2,300 in $100 bills in the yard of his East Lincoln Highway home in DeKalb one night in Nov 1938 and could not find it again. He denied the rumour for two months and was still digging in mid-July 1939; no recovery found in papers 1939-50. Pin is on the street, not the house.
set.t: Town lot: look-only. The 1940 census should give the house number.

src: DeKalb Daily Chronicle, 1 Jul 1939, p. 1 'Buried Money in Yocum Yard' (newspapers.com 126519420) and 15 Jul 1939, p. 1 (126519562)
